title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f75v separated predication versus joined restrictive expressions across ol and qol
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. Full already owned f75v.43–49 contains ol chedy/olchedy and qol chedy/qolchedy. Try one property with separated assertion versus joined nominal restriction; later olchedy must retain the qualified class without becoming a new assertion or action. Partial authoring, not a whole reading.

observed_basis: GDT852: native localized seam contrast between qol chedy and qolchedy, not proof of semantic joining or every letter.
GDT850: same-line coexistence and full literal inventories.
Same full paragraph exposes a second head ol with chedy and three later exact olchedy positions in ZL/IT. This is surface evidence, not independent semantic confirmation.
all_new_meaning_choices: ol denotes opaque entity class A; qol denotes opaque entity class B. No material name, identity, subset relation or q operator.
chedy denotes one unary property P of entities, same with A and B; physical content unidentified.
The licensed definitely separated N chedy asserts EXISTS x[N(x) AND P(x)]. It introduces its own instance; no same-individual inference from repeated spelling.
Exact joined ol|chedy and qol|chedy denote restricted classes lambda x[N(x) AND P(x)]. They do not alone assert existence, change, an event or instruction.
Split assertion and joined class have different types; no silent copula, imperative, aspect, source/anaphor value or type lift.
Only these two cuts licensed. olchey, olchdy, olshedy, qolkeey, qolsheol and marked forms receive nothing by resemblance.
smallest_derivation: .44 ol chedy: EXISTS x[A(x) AND P(x)]; qol chedy: EXISTS y[B(y) AND P(y)]; x=y is not entailed.
.44 qolchedy: B intersect P, not a third assertion or a new operation on y.
Same operation yields A intersect P for exact olchedy at .45/.46/.49 without new whole meanings. Their surrounding clauses must consume this class or remain unconstructed.
If a later written clause instantiates A intersect P, P holds of that instance. Identity with the .44 ol instance needs an additional written binder.
consequence_beyond_fit: Three later olchedy uses preserve class A and P and cannot silently become actions. GDT824 source+becomes instead supplies a relation and process predicate, requiring a different continuation.
Both separated heads take the same P type; a full paragraph requiring one chedy as action and the other as substance contradicts this card.
Bare chedy at .48/.49 keeps P but receives no automatic nearest owner. These positions are construction debts, not successful assertions.

design.whole_reading_problem: Most paragraph words and all surrounding clause predicates remain unassigned. A full construction must consume each qualified class and bare P while keeping class identity, individual reference and assertion distinct. This is not a full parse or a completed account.
design.next_smallest_step: Manually author one typed skeleton of all f75v.43–49 with only A/B/P and these two constructions fixed. Try later olchedy contexts first, without adding singleton glosses. Retain all unknowns and the rivals. If nothing written consumes those class expressions, preserve the partial draft and stop; no decoder or global capacity run.
design.decision: A genuine later class-taking construction would justify developing the assertion/reference distinction; an incompatible predicate slot or unresolved type everywhere parks it. Surface coverage alone selects no meaning.
design.limits: Zero confirmed meanings; no source selected; no universal spacing rule or q deletion; no same material identity; no new images/target admissions/reserves/contacts; no test run.
